# Class: `PlotLegend`

Places a compact, scrollable legend at the top right of the plot viewport.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-inptk-plot.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_inptk_plot.py#L14) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `QGraphicsView`.

Wraps legend text, limits its displayed size, and schedules placement updates after resizing or view changes. Hides the view when there are no entries.
